title: MAVLink command request
description: Published BY a C2/UI to {TOPIC_ROOT}/air/mavlink/cmd/{entity_id} to drive bridges/mavlink_command_bridge.py. entity_id is the last key segment; the bridge does not read it from the payload. See mavlink_ack.schema.json for the reply on {TOPIC_ROOT}/air/mavlink/ack/{entity_id}.

cmd.description: Which MAVLink command to send. Unknown values are REJECTED, not ignored.

alt_m.description: Target altitude in meters. Used by 'takeoff' (default 20) and optionally 'goto' (default 0).

target_system.description: Overrides the bridge's own MAVLink target_system from its heartbeat, if set.

target_component.description: Overrides the bridge's own MAVLink target_component from its heartbeat, if set.
